description: Searches ElevenLabs' shared voice library, the voices any project can keep without using one of its own: by words (search) and by gender, age, accent, language and use case, sorted by trending, cloned, newest or used, a page at a time. Each voice comes with its ownerId and voiceId (what voice_keep takes), what it sounds like, a preview address to listen to, and whether it stays (a voice whose maker must give notice before withdrawing it is safe for a recurring character). Free.

accent.description: An accent by name: british, american, australian…

language.description: A language code: en, de, fr, es…

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

search.description: Words for the voice: "warm older British man", "energetic narrator".

sort.description: The order: trending (popular now), cloned (cloned most), newest, or used (used most).

use_case.description: What it is made for: narrative_story, conversational, characters_animation, social_media, entertainment_tv, advertisement, informative_educational.

name: voice_library_search
title: Search the voice library
